stage: Frozen development decision-disagreement screen on repaired networks
cohort: Use the previously sealed focal approach and high/low requests at all 24 Jinan decisions. Both original straight leaders are stopped. The high request gives the straight approach four nominal seconds of priority over a permissive right, the low gives zero, and both have the same right-turn nominal signal sequence. These are single nominated decisions.
source: 12 repaired Hangzhou high arms with both original straight leaders at 2.0 m/s2. Right vehicles retain their own native parameters. Count each source start once.
target: 24 repaired native Jinan high arms. Exclude every case from the evaluation seed when calculating its Jinan service fraction. Use no low-arm labels, evaluations from the future Jinan seed, or independent seeds.
service_fraction: Pool vehicles across training starts. Denominator is the number of vehicles halted (speed < 0.1 m/s) on the focal dedicated right inlet and within the existing near-supply boundary (10 seconds at the posted lane limit) at t0. Numerator is the number of those exact vehicle IDs with a native stopline_entry on the registered right movement in (t0,t0+10]. No pseudocount.
arm_score: For each of the two requests, B is the total count of halted vehicles on distinct incoming lanes receiving G or g in its requested stable state, using the complete focal junction. Score(high) = B(high) - (1-r)*N, where N is the current number of initially halted near right vehicles. Score(low) = B(low). This is a heuristic discount on high, not a measurement of low service or a reproduction of the production PP score. Use the earlier feasible index in a score tie.
comparison: Both rules use a single rate, the same two eligible actions and the same formula. Target-only uses the out-of-seed Jinan rate T. Source-informed uses (T+H)/2, equal city weights. If PP selects another request or either city's training denominator is zero, retain the recorded PP request for both.
readout: Report eligible denominators and exact rates, per-seed choices and paired disagreements on all 24 cases; distinguish PP disagreements from between-rule disagreements. Also count decisions whose chosen action could depend on any r in [0,1] by comparing r=0 and r=1 including ties. Do not select a new rate, queue definition or comparator based on the screen.
gate: If the two prespecified rules never disagree, close this rule on the development panel. Otherwise freeze the distinct request pairs before planning any paired cost measurement. A disagreement alone is not control benefit.
